# What does a new hire really cost you on top of their pay?

> Free employer payroll tax calculator: enter a salary and state to see Social Security, Medicare, FUTA, state unemployment, workers' comp, match and health cost, and the true cost of a hire. Runs in your browser; nothing is uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.

## What it answers

In 2026 an employer pays 6.2% Social Security tax on each employee's first $184,500 of wages, 1.45% Medicare tax on all wages, and federal unemployment (FUTA) tax of 6% on the first $7,000. Paying state unemployment tax on time earns a credit of up to 5.4%, so FUTA is usually 0.6%, or $42 per employee a year, more in a credit-reduction state. Source: IRS Publication 15 (2026) and Publication 926 (2026). As of 2026-11-14.
